name: god-of-war-sons-of-sparta-ps4-november-16
lines:
تصدر God of War Sons of Sparta
على PS4 يوم 16 نوفمبر

يضيف تحديث وضعين جديدين
إلى PS4 و PS5

وضع Hermes للسباق مع الزمن
مع عداد ونتائج

أما وضع Erebus فيسقط فيه
الجميع بضربة واحدة
headline:
لعبة Kratos الشاب
قادمة إلى PS4
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Kratos' youth story Sons of Sparta, a retro 2D God of War, is coming to PS4 on Monday 16 Nov at midnight local time
angle.why_now: PlayStation Blog updated its Sons of Sparta post on 13 Nov with the PS4 date and a free patch
angle.what_it_means_here: PS4 owners in the Gulf, still a large base, get the game; the PS5 and PS4 patch adds Hermes Mode and Erebus Mode; the PS4 price and regional store listing were not stated
angle.payoff: Erebus Mode: you and every enemy fall in a single hit
